s2:Cosmic thermodynamics of interacting scenario of EBEC dark matter and holographic dark energy

rationale: The papers 'Dark matter cusps & cores' and 'Cosmological simulations of the same spiral galaxy' provide insights into the cusp-core problem and the role of baryonic physics in shaping dark matter profiles, contributing evidence relevant to the question of dark matter distribution in dwarf galaxies.
